correctness.rationale: The source's own modal characteristic polynomial has B_l=f_*g_*l^4+(f_*gamma q+g_*beta q^2)l^2, so B_0=0 exactly. At l=0 the matrix has eigenvalues 0 and -gamma(R0-1), with eigenvectors proportional to (1,R0-1) and (1,-1). The neutral vector is the derivative with respect to total mass of the exact constant-equilibrium family E_M. Conservation of integral(S+I) makes different mass leaves invariant, so a nearby E_M cannot converge to E_N. For l>0, A_l and B_l are strictly positive, giving negative-real-part roots. The accepted statement therefore distinguishes ambient non-attraction from transverse fixed-mass stability without overclaiming nonlinear orbital stability.

value.rationale: The correction identifies the exact state space on which the paper's endemic-equilibrium stability statement is mathematically true. The omitted zero mode is forced by the central biological conservation law and corresponds to an explicit continuum of equilibria, so it is not a cosmetic spectral detail. Separating ambient stability from fixed-mass transverse stability prevents a false interpretation of the lemma under perturbations that alter population size while preserving the source's useful threshold conclusions inside each biologically conserved mass class.
